messages:
jess (Support): Lumina Labs invoice INV-7890 is on hold. Customer claims reverse-charge (EU VAT exemption) and uploaded a resale cert PDF, but our VIES check failed/timeouts. PO PO-4321 is attached. Need guidance: can we manually approve or what exact docs do we need to clear this?

andre (Billing): Can you paste the VAT ID they provided and the filename of the upload?

jess (Support): VAT ID: GB999888777. Uploaded file: lumina_resale_2026.pdf (scanned, low-res). Customer says VIES returns "no match" or times out. Portal shows upload but parsing failed.

vatbot (bot): VIES check result for GB999888777 at 2026-03-14T14:12Z -> SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (504). Last successful check: 2026-01-10T09:05Z. Internal call log: `POST /billing/vat/check -> 504`

jess (Support): Repro for ops: `curl -s -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/billing/vat-check" -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API" -d '{"vat_id":"GB999888777"}'` -> returns 504 / timeout.

sara (Finance): For manual acceptance we need one of: 1) national VAT registration certificate PDF showing full legal name + VAT number, OR 2) VIES confirmation screenshot showing exact company name match. Resale certificate must be signed and include company registration number. If PO present we can provisionally accept, but we require evidence within 7 days or we reverse.

andre (Billing): Manual override flow: create billing-ops ticket, attach raw upload, include VIES logs, and tag invoice with `reverse_charge_manual_pending`. I'll open the ticket.

jess (Support): Ticket created -> BILL-3245. I attached the original PDF, portal logs, and the vat-check curl output. Pasting customer-facing ask: "Please re-upload a higher-resolution signed VAT/resale certificate that shows your full legal name (Lumina Labs Ltd), VAT reg number, issue date, and government stamp, or provide an official VIES confirmation screenshot."

sara (Finance): We will accept a screenshot only if it clearly shows: VAT number, legal company name, registration status = VALID, and a timestamp. Otherwise require the official national cert. Also confirm PO number on invoice header matches PO-4321 exactly before approving.

jess (Support): Customer currently has "Lumina Labs" on the PDF header, not "Lumina Labs Ltd". Asking them to re-upload with full legal entity name and company number.

andre (Billing): :thumbsup: Holding payment processing until docs received. If customer insists we can apply a provisional reverse-charge flag for this billing cycle (internal note) but ledger must record pending docs and approval deadline.

vatbot (bot): Reminder: repeated VIES timeouts -> escalate to legal for manual verification. Command run: `/vat-check --id GB999888777 --force` -> 504.

jess (Support): Repro steps for billing-ops to clear when docs arrive: 1) Open BILL-3245. 2) Verify VAT ID against national register (link below). 3) Confirm invoice header exactly matches legal name and VAT ID. 4) Upload approved doc to invoice record and add tag `reverse_charge_approved`. Link to national register (customer-supplied): https://gov-uk.example/verify?vat=GB999888777

sara (Finance): Thanks — if docs not received within 7 days, bill reversal flow. cc @andre. Closing plan documented in BILL-3245.
